title: Grow Your Vocabulary by Learning Root Words
titleZh: 通过学习词根来扩充你的词汇量
credits: Alice Bryant wrote this story for Learning English. Caty Weaver was the editor.

sentences.en: English has been called one the most difficult languages for non-native speakers to learn.
sentences.zh: 英语已被称为非母语者最难学习的语言之一。

sentences.en: One reason is that English has so many rules – and almost as many exceptions of those rules!
sentences.zh: 原因之一是英语有太多的规则——几乎同样多的例外规则！

sentences.en: Sometimes, this leaves learners confused.
sentences.zh: 有时，这会让学习者感到困惑。

sentences.en: For example, the order of words in a sentence can be tricky.
sentences.zh: 例如，句子中单词的顺序可能很棘手。

sentences.en: Another reason English is hard to learn is that the pronunciation of its words cannot always be predicted by their spelling.
sentences.zh: 英语难学的另一个原因是，其单词的发音不能总是通过拼写来预测。

sentences.en: For example, there are at least six ways to pronounce the group of letters spelled o-u-g-h.
sentences.zh: 例如，拼写为o-u-gh的字母组合至少有六种发音方式。

sentences.en: And, maybe the worst thing of all is that there are many idioms, or expressions, in English.
sentences.zh: 而且，也许最糟糕的是，英语中有许多习语或表达方式。

sentences.en: You could say we use idioms like they're going out of style.
sentences.zh: 你可以说我们使用习语的方式简直是不停地用。

sentences.en: So, it is comforting to know that learning root words can help a non-native speaker use English.
sentences.zh: 因此，知道学习词根能帮助非母语者使用英语，是一件令人安慰的事。

sentences.en: A root word is the most basic form of a word.
sentences.zh: 词根是一个词最基本的形式。

sentences.en: Root words can help you to break down large, new words into smaller units to discover their meanings.
sentences.zh: 词根能帮助你把庞大、陌生的词分解成更小的单位，从而发现它们的含义。

sentences.en: Learning just one root word can help you understand several words in English.
sentences.zh: 只学习一个词根就能帮助你理解英语中的多个单词。

sentences.en: So, by learning just 20 or 30 root words, you can expand your English vocabulary to include hundreds of new words.
sentences.zh: 因此，只学习20或30个词根，你就能扩大英语词汇量，包含数百个新词。

sentences.en: A root can be any part of a word that carries meaning: the beginning, middle or end.
sentences.zh: 词根可以是词中携带意义的任何部分：开头、中间或结尾。

sentences.en: Prefixes, bases, and suffixes are types of roots.
sentences.zh: 前缀、词基和后缀是词根的类型。

sentences.en: The prefix appears at the beginning of a word, the base in the middle and the suffix at the end.
sentences.zh: 前缀出现在词的开头，词基在中间，后缀在结尾。

sentences.en: Most English root words came from the Greek and Latin languages.
sentences.zh: 大多数英语词根来自希腊语和拉丁语。

sentences.en: One useful method for building vocabulary through root words is to first look at a base word and then look for familiar prefixes and suffixes that go with that base.
sentences.zh: 通过词根积累词汇的一个有用方法是：先查看一个词基，然后寻找与该词基搭配 familiar 的前缀和后缀。

sentences.en: Let's try an example: the base word “struct-.”
sentences.zh: 让我们尝试一个例子：词基“struct-”。

sentences.en: It comes from the Latin word meaning “build.”
sentences.zh: 它来自拉丁语，意思是“建造”。

sentences.en: Any English word you hear containing “struct-”* will relate to building, developing or creating something.
sentences.zh: 你听到的任何包含"struct-"*的英语单词，都与建造、发展或创造某物有关。

sentences.en: By itself, “struct” is not a word, but it is the basis for more than 30 words in English.
sentences.zh: 单独来看，"struct"不是一个词，但它是英语中30多个词的基础。

sentences.en: For example, the word “construct” is a verb that means “to build.”
sentences.zh: 例如，单词"construct"是一个动词，意思是"建造"。

sentences.en: The prefix “con” means “together” or “with.”
sentences.zh: 前缀"con"意思是"一起"或"与……一起"。

sentences.en: So, "construct" means to put things together to build or create something.
sentences.zh: 所以，"construct"的意思是把东西组合起来建造或创造某物。

sentences.en: Adding suffixes to “struct-” creates additional words.
sentences.zh: 在"struct-"后加后缀可以构成更多的词。

sentences.en: For example, adding “-ion” in English makes verbs into nouns.
sentences.zh: 例如，在英语中加"-ion"可以把动词变成名词。

sentences.en: When we add "-ion" to “construct," we get "construction," which means the process, or act, of building something.
sentences.zh: 当我们把"-ion"加到"construct"上时，就得到了"construction"，意思是建造某物的过程或行为。

sentences.en: Adding the suffix “-ing” to “construct” makes “constructing.”
sentences.zh: 把后缀"-ing"加到"construct"上，就得到"constructing"。

sentences.en: That is the gerund form and has a similar meaning as the noun "construction."
sentences.zh: 这是动名词形式，与名词"construction"意思相近。

sentences.en: Adding the suffix “-ive” to make “constructive” gives us the adjective form, and means helpful in developing or improving something.
sentences.zh: 加上后缀"-ive"构成"constructive"，得到形容词形式，意思是有助于发展或改进某物。

sentences.en: Now, let's build onto “constructive."
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们在"constructive"的基础上继续扩展。

sentences.en: Adding the suffix “ly” to "constructive" gives us the word “constructively” and produces an adverb.
sentences.zh: 把后缀"-ly"加到"constructive"上，就得到单词"constructively"，构成副词。

sentences.en: It means doing something in a way that is helpful.
sentences.zh: 它的意思是以上有帮助的方式做某事。

sentences.en: There are many other words that the base word “struct” produces.
sentences.zh: 基础词"struct"还能派生出许多其他单词。

sentences.en: For instance, “destruction” is the opposite of “construction.”
sentences.zh: 例如，"destruction"是"construction"的反义词。

sentences.en: "Destruction" is the act of taking apart or damaging something that was built.
sentences.zh: "destruction"是指把已建成的东西拆开或损坏的行为。

sentences.en: "Instruction" means the act of building knowledge and has a similar meaning to the gerund "teaching."
sentences.zh: "instruction"意思是构建知识的行为，与动名词"teaching"意思相近。

sentences.en: And, just like with "construct," you can add many suffixes to "destruct" or "instruct" to get several more words.
sentences.zh: 而且，就像"construct"一样，你可以给"destruct"或"instruct"加上许多后缀，得到更多单词。

sentences.en: So, you see, by knowing just one root word – “struct-” – you can get a better idea of the meaning of at least 15 words in English.
sentences.zh: 所以，你看，只要掌握一个词根——"struct-"——你就能更好地理解英语中至少15个词的含义。

sentences.en: A few other common root words include “bio" meaning life, “auto” meaning self, “pro” meaning before or in favor of, and “tele” meaning distance.
sentences.zh: 其他几个常见的词根包括“bio”，意为“生命”，“auto”，意为“自我”，“pro”，意为“在……之前”或“赞成”，以及“tele”，意为“距离”。

sentences.en: Surely, you recognize some of these roots.
sentences.zh: 当然，你一定能认出其中一些词根。

sentences.en: So, choose one or two and write in the comments section all of the words you can think of that come from them.
sentences.zh: 所以，请选择一两个词根，在评论区写下你能想到的所有由它们构成的单词。

sentences.en: Join us again soon when we will discuss suffixes and prefixes.
sentences.zh: 我们很快会再次相聚，届时将探讨后缀与前缀。

sentences.en: Learning common roots, prefixes and suffixes will help you become an expert in deconstructing the meanings of English words and constructing a strong vocabulary.***
sentences.zh: 学习常见的词根、前缀和后缀，将有助于你成为拆解英语单词含义、构建扎实词汇量的行家里手。***

sentences.en: I'm Jill Robbins
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔·罗宾斯。

sentences.en: And I’m Alice Bryant.
sentences.zh: 我是爱丽丝·布莱恩特。
